description: Find real examples of website screens captured from live sites: login and sign-up pages, pricing pages, checkouts, carts, search results, home pages, forms with errors and more, on desktop and mobile, across sectors such as banking, insurance, software, retail and travel. Use it for UI and UX inspiration, design references, competitor research, or "show me how other sites do X". Returns up to 8 screens with a summary, a thumbnail and a link to the full screenshot on theuiindex.com.

device.description: Device the screen was captured on.

offset.description: Skip this many results (for more of the same search).

query.description: Free words: a site, a brand, a pattern or what the screen does, e.g. "two-factor login", "bol", "annual pricing toggle".

sector.description: Sector key, e.g. software, ai, developer-tools, banking, insurance, retail, groceries, travel, energy, telecom, government. See list_screen_types.

state.description: Interface state key, e.g. search-results, search-no-results, filters-applied, menu-open, form-error, cart-populated. See list_screen_types.

type.description: Screen type key, e.g. home, landing, pricing, login (sign-in and sign-up), checkout, cart, search-results, product-detail, form, contact, help. See list_screen_types.

name: search_screens
title: Search real website screens
